task.title: Update compile-managed runbook blocks through canonical paths

context: The compiled kickoff selected the active KN and its managed runbook carrier.
The request can be read as replacing human-authored text outside the managed block.
requirements: Resolve the canonical runbook target before applying an update.
Replace only the HAR-COMPILE-NOTES managed block.

constraints.constraint: The accepted compile document keeps the runbook as the route target.
Human text outside the managed block must be preserved.
The managed document contains byte-preserved human text around its carrier.

out_of_scope.statement: Replacing the complete runbook including text outside the managed block.

acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a path alias WHEN compile resolves the carrier THEN it updates the canonical runbook target.
GIVEN human text outside the markers WHEN compile updates the carrier THEN those bytes remain unchanged.
open_questions: The broader multi-runbook rollout remains outside this task.
